common_conditions: LMC configured to store location while not reporting, has stored triggered reports, and has returned to reporting
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: LMS requests stored location over restored communication link
claims.conclusion: LMC returns one or more history reports, newest qualifying stored information first; history transmission does not interrupt current reporting.

conditions: MC service server or another LMC requests history via LMS
claims.conclusion: LMS checks authorization and available history; retrieves from reporting LMC only if desired history is unavailable locally, then reports requested history. Optional UE label goes to requesting LMC.

conditions: MC service server or another LMC requests cancellation
claims.conclusion: LMS checks authorization and determines cancellation of source transmission, LMS transmission or both; executes requested cancellation if no other authorized LMC requests that source's history. Cancellation does not change emergency, non-emergency or not-reporting trigger criteria.

limitations: Not a storage-capacity, retention, retransmission or deletion policy.
No guarantee every movement was recorded: storage depends on configured triggering criteria.
